citations.claim: The root cause was determined to be contamination.
The Dolmino math bundle included GSM8k test items in a test.json file, and because the dataset had already been cached on the cluster, it introduced contamination for GSM8K on the Bison cooldown.
Dolmino's GSM8k uses OLMes formatting instead of LM Eval's default prompt formatting.

Rather than improving results, contamination caused the model to have dramatically increased surprisal on the original prompt's structured tags (e.g., 16-8=<<16-7=9>>9) that did not appear in the contaminated data.
This high surprisal appeared to cause the model to perform much worse than it did on the same questions with those tags removed.

answer.answer: The root cause of the poor GSM8k performance was accidental contamination from cached data. The Dolmino math bundle included GSM8k test items formatted using OLMes style rather than LM Eval's default prompt format. As a result, training on this data caused the model to experience dramatically increased surprisal on LM Eval's original prompt structured tags that were absent from the contaminated data, leading to much worse performance on the standard prompt.

claims.text: Marin 32B (Mantis) scores higher than Marin 32B (Bison) on 13 of the 19 base-model tasks.
claims.sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN mantis.num > bison.num THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mantis_higher_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mantis.num < bison.num THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bison_higher_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mantis.num = bison.num THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tie_count,
    COUNT(*) AS total_tasks
FROM table_cells mantis
JOIN table_cells bison 
  ON mantis.table_id = bison.table_id 
  AND mantis.col_name = bison.col_name
WHERE mantis.table_id = 28
  AND mantis.row_idx = 1  -- Marin 32B (Mantis)
  AND bison.row_idx = 0   -- Marin 32B (Bison)
  AND mantis.col_name NOT IN ('Model', 'Average');
